cards.title: Smart Comparison Engine
bullets: View and compare real-time rates from multiple carriers on a single screen.
Auto-filter carriers by parcel weight and delivery zone to prevent pricing errors.
Pick the best price, fastest ETA, or highest service rating — instantly.

bullets: Sync orders automatically from Salla, Zid, WooCommerce, or custom Shopify stores.
Eliminate manual copy-pasting of customer data to accelerate daily fulfillment.
